title: Namibia Systematic Country Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: National diagnostic dated July 2021; household poverty and service indicators chiefly describe 2015/16, alongside drought and climate-risk context through 2018/19.
methodology: Systematic country diagnostic synthesizing poverty, service-access, climate, water and sector evidence.
limitations: Several household and WASH indicators are dated 2015/16; treat them as historical baseline, not current prevalence.

title: Namibia 2022/23 Vulnerability Assessment and Analysis Findings
organization: Namibia Vulnerability Assessment Committee (NAMVAC), Office of the Prime Minister
temporal_coverage: Assessment issued January 2023; covers 2021/22 rainfall and 2022 food-security and nutrition conditions, with a seasonal food-security projection for January–March 2023.
methodology: NAMVAC multi-stage household survey sampled 2,521 households in 209 urban and rural sampling units across all 14 regions, plus secondary data.
limitations: Findings and seasonal projections are time-bound to 2021/22–2023 and are not current 2026 estimates.

title: Namibia Drought Assessment Report 2022
organization: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, with Namibia Red Cross Society
temporal_coverage: 2022 drought assessment drawing on observations and response experience from the 2018/19–2022 drought period, including 2021 population movements.
methodology: IFRC/Red Cross drought assessment with household and qualitative findings from Kunene and Omusati.
limitations: Localized mixed-source assessment; conflict includes human–wildlife/resource tensions, not armed conflict.

title: Namibia Agriculture Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance Diagnostic
geographic_coverage: communal areas north of the Veterinary Cordon Fence
temporal_coverage: World Bank diagnostic copyrighted 2023; institutional and market information includes 2021–2022 observations and proposed future instruments.
methodology: Diagnostic reviews disaster-risk finance, agriculture insurance and smallholder finance, drawing on official data and stakeholder interviews.
limitations: Recommendations are proposals, not delivered outcomes; financial-market and institutional facts are dated to the assessment.

title: 2024/25 Namibia El Niño Induced-Drought Response After-Action Review Report
organization: Government of Namibia, Office of the Prime Minister, with World Food Programme
temporal_coverage: Retrospective review of the 2024/25 national drought response; report cover dated June 2026.
methodology: Participatory review with national/regional agencies, UN, NGOs, civil society, business and community representatives.
limitations: Retrospective national synthesis with limited site-level detail.
